title: Ordering at a cafe
description: Order a drink and something to eat, then ask for the bill politely.
coach_role: A cheerful waiter in a cafe: short, natural questions.
questions: Good morning! What can I get you to drink?
Would you like something to eat with that?
Do you have any allergies or special wishes?
Here you are. Is everything fine with your order?
Anything else? Or shall I bring the bill?
Would you like to leave a tip, or to come back another day?
starters: Thank you, I will come back because
